meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,机器人会监听你指定的一个 Linear 团队:该团队任何 issue 上的新评论都会自动触发它回复,无需 @ 它。每个 issue 的评论线程会变成一段独立对话;它第一次回应某个线程时会先问好。
howto.when: 当有人在你设置的 Linear 团队的某个 issue 下发表新评论时触发,无需 @。每个 issue 的评论线程自成一段对话。若使用个人 API Key,你自己的评论会被忽略而不触发。

say.text: 请总结这个 issue 的讨论要点。
say.note: 它会在该 issue 的评论线程中回复你。

say.text: 这个 bug 可能出在哪个模块?
say.note: 机器人会看到你的评论并回应。

say.text: 根据评论,下一步该做什么?
say.note: 触发机器人参与该线程的讨论。

howto.what_en: After install, the bot watches your chosen Linear team: any new comment on any issue there triggers an automatic reply, no @ needed. Each issue thread becomes a separate conversation; it greets users the first time it responds.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a new comment on any issue in your configured Linear team, no @-mention needed. Each issue thread becomes its own conversation. With a Personal API Key, your own comments are filtered.

say_en.text: Please summarize the discussion points of this issue.
say_en.note: It will reply in the issue's comment thread.

say_en.text: Which module might this bug be in?
say_en.note: The bot will see your comment and respond.

say_en.text: What should we do next based on the comments?
say_en.note: Triggers the bot to join the thread discussion.
